clips.title: The story
paras: Pilot Stonegear, nicknamed 'Stone', is a dwarf mechanic and driver in the Ironforge Siege Brigade stationed at Steelgrill's Depot. He operates the formidable siege engine known as Trollplow and works tirelessly to enhance its performance and armor. Adventurers traveling through Dun Morogh often help him secure rare materials to keep his war machine battle-ready.

Stationed among the rumbling boilers and clanking tracks of Steelgrill's Depot, Pilot Stonegear serves Ironforge as a proud driver in the Siege Brigade. His pride and joy is Trollplow, a heavy siege tank built to smash through enemy lines. Stonegear takes his machine seriously—knowing that in the heat of battle, a driver's life depends entirely on the resilience of gears, plates, and steam pressure. He constantly seeks to fine-tune both Trollplow's combat efficiency and the everyday livability of its cramped cockpit.

Like many dwarven and gnomish grease-monkeys at the depot, Stonegear is rarely content with factory specifications. He often spends off-duty hours debating engineering schematics with comrades like Pilot Bellowfiz. Whether chasing down rumors of exotic ores or tracking down volatile minerals to fuel enhanced plating and munitions, Stonegear relies on eager recruits to venture into the snowy wilderness and dangerous caves of Dun Morogh on supply runs.
